biggest_catch: On-the-spot payment is real, but the number is a junk-car number: describe the damage honestly or the offer gets recalculated in your driveway, and expect a check, not a stack of bills.
catches: The offer is recalculated on the spot if the vehicle's condition does not match your description (e.g., does not start, missing catalytic converter, higher mileage).
Offers for junk/damaged cars are low - often a few hundred dollars; value varies by vehicle, condition, and market.
Peddle rarely pays literal cash - payment is usually by check for driver safety.
No motorcycles, scooters, trailers, RVs, campers, or boats; you need the title paperwork in order.
Resale catch-all: value varies by condition and demand; quotes and market prices can change; fees or shipping can reduce your actual proceeds.

timing: Paid on the spot (cash or check) at free scheduled pickup; instant offer valid seven days.
who_pays: Peddle - the company pays you directly when their pickup partner collects your car.
who_qualifies: You must own the vehicle and have the title paperwork in order. Cars, trucks, vans, and SUVs only - no motorcycles, scooters, trailers, RVs, campers, or boats.
work_available: Yes - Peddle was buying as of 2026-09-23, with free towing and scheduled pickup. The instant offer is good for seven days; describe damage honestly or the driver recalculates in your driveway.
what_gets_accepted: The driver inspects at pickup (starts/drives check, mileage, VIN, paperwork) - the offer is recalculated on the spot if the car does not match your description. Junk/damaged-car offers are low, often a few hundred dollars.
costs_and_unpaid_time: No fees - towing is free. Your unpaid time is describing the car online, scheduling pickup, and being present for the inspection. Expect a check, not literal cash, for driver safety.
when_cash_arrives: Real money on the spot - paid when the pickup partner arrives, confirms the condition, and takes the vehicle. Usually by check.
